boards.title: Your First Weekend at Tufts University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence built around campus gathering spots, recurring programs, food, arts, and a nearby square.

cards.title: Start on Prez Lawn
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Meet your group on the lawn, settle in with a campus map, and decide which evening program or performance fits everyone’s energy.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor pause to make a simple shared plan before the weekend begins.
cards.evidence_claim: A Tufts Admissions weekend account describes students gathering with friends on Prez Lawn on Friday morning.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus lawn; check weather and follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Get Oriented at Tisch Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 35 Professors Row
cards.notes: Use the library as a landmark and regrouping point; review its visitor information before you go, especially if you are not a Tufts affiliate.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark for a quiet reset and navigation check.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts identifies Tisch Library at 35 Professors Row in Medford and provides directions from campus and Davis Square.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s visitor and building-access information before arrival.

cards.title: Look for an Aidekman Gallery Visit
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · arts district
cards.notes: Check the Tufts University Art Galleries schedule, then make the Aidekman Arts Center your visual-art stop if an exhibition is open.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts stop anchored by a named exhibition venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Admissions lists visiting the Tufts University Art Galleries as a campus activity; the Medford/Somerville map lists Aidekman Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition availability and gallery access vary; confirm the current gallery schedule.

cards.title: Check Granoff for a Performance
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus arts district
cards.notes: See whether the music calendar has an open concert or recital, and choose it only if its date, ticketing, and access information work for your group.
cards.short_summary: A named music venue to check for a scheduled campus performance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Medford/Somerville campus map lists Granoff Music Center among Tufts university buildings.
cards.access_notes: Programming is event-specific; verify performance details and entry requirements in advance.

cards.entity_name: Elizabeth Van Huysen Mayer Campus Center
cards.title: Regroup at Mayer Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 44 Professors Row
cards.notes: Use the center to meet up, browse campus options, or get food; its directory includes student organization space, dining, and the bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A practical indoor gathering point with campus services and student life offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts says Mayer Campus Center provides meeting space, student organization offices, dining options, a bookstore, and wireless internet.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Directory and Hours | AS&E Students
cards.access_notes: Semester building hours list Friday until 1 a.m.; hours can change on holidays.

cards.title: Choose a TUSC Film Series Screening
cards.subtitle: Friday or Saturday night · campus program
cards.notes: Check the current screening listing, then bring friends for a 35mm film night instead of planning around alcohol-centered entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus movie option specifically identified as alcohol-free.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts’ alcohol-free-events page says TUSC Film Series shows 35mm big-screen movies on Friday and Saturday nights and is free to Tufts community members.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday nights; confirm the current screening, venue, and Tufts-community eligibility.

cards.title: Have a Saturday Brunch Check-In
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Carmichael Hall
cards.notes: Meet for a meal, compare weekend plans, and verify current dining access before entering; do not assume a specific menu item will be available.
cards.short_summary: A named dining hall for a flexible Saturday-morning regroup.
cards.evidence_claim: A Tufts Admissions weekend account describes students going to Carmichael Dining Hall on Saturday morning.
cards.access_notes: Dining access, meal plans, and service times vary; check Tufts Dining before visiting.

cards.title: Move or Watch the Jumbos
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Tufts athletic facilities
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled game or a campus recreation option, then verify facility access or event details before heading over with your group.
cards.short_summary: A flexible active stop that can be spectator-focused or recreational.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts describes varsity, club, and intramural sports plus group and independent exercise in its athletic facilities.
cards.access_notes: Facility use and game admission vary; consult current Athletics information before arrival.

cards.title: Pause for Saturday Dinner at Dewick
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · lower campus
cards.notes: Make Dewick-MacPhie a dinner waypoint before an evening program, and check the live dining schedule and access requirements before you go.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-campus dining stop before the evening’s plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts’ Medford/Somerville campus map lists Dewick-MacPhie Dining Hall as a university building.
cards.access_notes: Dining access, payment, and service times vary; verify them with Tufts Dining.

cards.title: End with a Davis Square Walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Somerville
cards.notes: Take the Tufts shuttle or public transit only after confirming current service, then choose a daytime café, shop, or public-space walk that suits the group.
cards.short_summary: A nearby square for an easy final outing before the Sunday reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch Library’s directions page identifies the Davis Square MBTA bus stop and says the Tufts shuttle stops there and at Mayer Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Check current shuttle and MBTA service before traveling; individual businesses have separate access and costs.
